scope: Production handoff only. This export generates no images and assigns no jobs; the parent coordinates claims to prevent duplicate generation.

design_spec.composition: Large short method name, one short input-to-output or core-method caption, one concrete conceptual scene/diagram. Readable at 316px. No paragraphs, result tables or benchmark numbers.
design_spec.listing_fallback: Use the complete existing visual summary with contain and its original aspect ratio until approved dedicated art exists. Never use a text-only replacement.
design_spec.scientific_review: Read the matching original paper before selecting inputs, outputs and core contribution. Separate pre-training, inference and downstream fine-tuning. Conceptual diagrams are not measured outputs. Resolve recorded source issues before making content claims.
design_spec.source_preservation: Keep all full-size visual summaries and note bodies. Create new landscape art, never a portrait-poster crop. Preserve generated PNG bytes and register a separate no-crop optimized WebP derivative with hashes.
design_spec.coordination: Claim a canonical record_id before generation, record owner/batch outside this unassigned snapshot, and exclude every already_handled ID. Check current migrations and thumbnail manifest before importing. Do not overwrite another worker's asset.
